basis: Disk-integrated spectral color, computed from published reference spectra. Brightness-normalized for a swatch; not an official color or a representation of relative planetary brightness.

source.title: Payne et al. (2026), A Comprehensive Spectroscopic Reference of the Solar System and Its Application to Exoplanet Direct Imaging
source.columns: Column 1: wavelength in micrometres. Column 2: disk-integrated reflectance (I/F apparent albedo for the Earth and Mars PSG model outputs).
source.basis: Composite reference reflectance spectrum from observations.

illuminant.name: ASTM E490-00 air-mass-zero solar spectral irradiance
illuminant.columns: NewAM0 worksheet, columns A and B: wavelength in micrometres and irradiance in W/m2/micrometre.

conversion.integration: Linearly interpolate reflectance and solar irradiance onto the CIE 360-830 nm grid at 1 nm. Integrate reflectance times irradiance times each CIE matching function; normalize to Y=1 for a perfect diffuser. All inputs cover the full integration interval; no extrapolation.
conversion.chromaticAdaptation: Bradford adaptation from the integrated solar white to the sRGB D65 white (x=0.3127, y=0.3290).
conversion.brightnessNormalization: Divide all three linear sRGB channels by their maximum, preserving channel ratios; apply the standard sRGB transfer function, multiply by 255, and round half up. No hue adjustment or gamut clipping.
